trees you should be able
to name on a walk

cedar of lebanon

wide, flat layers of branches.

magnolia

huge flowers before
the leaves.

aspen

leaves that tremble
in the smallest wind.

cypress

the dark, slender tree
of italian hills.

olive

some are more than
2,000 years old.

giant sequoia

the largest trees on earth.
i learned that this morning.
